Some entries DELIBERATELY SHARE A PIN (a club or bar inside a hotel is the same place under a different name in the feed) — do not dedupe them. `aliases` lists FORMER names of the same venue: an entry with no pin of its own inherits the pin of an alias that has one, so a renamed venue keeps its coordinates and the pin still has exactly one owner. Where a pin disagrees with the feed's `city`, the pin is right and is marked OWNER-CONFIRMED. `event_count` and `_coverage` are regenerated from the drop named in _coverage — they describe that drop only, so a venue at 0 is quiet this round, not retired.
